slides.texte_overlay:
6 secrets to mastering
your 20s you must know

1. Build the body now -
it's the easiest decade to do it.

2. Learn to cook -
it saves money and dates.

3. Get great at one skill -
people pay for mastery.

4. Stay curious -
learn something outside
your field every day.
slides.texte_sophia:
4. Stay curious -
I learn outside my field
on the Sophia app.

slides.texte_overlay:
5. Call your grandparents -
their stories won't wait.

6. Say yes to hard things -
that's where you grow.
